structured.answer: If anything, Harel's 'כספי (שקלי)' track, because Harel is a big name I know and the track says 0% shares and 0% מט"ח. But its 4.25% over 3 years doesn't look better than my bank deposit and there's a 0.57% fee, so I'll ask my son or the bank before signing anything.

stuck.why: These looked safe (0–5% shares) but where the return should be they say 'פחות מ־3 שנים', not a number, so I couldn't compare them
Many cards full of percentages on a black background. I got anxious and tired and stopped after screen 6
Is this taken every year from all my money? At the bank I don't pay anything for a deposit

used: Heading 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and the selected 'קופת גמל להשקעה'
Sentence saying companies are ordered by managed money, biggest first
Track 'כספי (שקלי)': מניות 0%, מט"ח 0%, 4.25% for 3 years, 3.08% for 5 years, 0.57% מהחיסכון
skimmed: Other Harel tracks on screens 3–6 (משולב סחיר, עוקב מדדים, קיימות, הלכה)
The beginning of the מור section
unsure_meaning: 'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return
Teal vs yellow in the circles
'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת' — is 4.25% per year or in total?
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is as safe as a bank deposit
A comparison with bank deposit interest
The fee in shekels on an amount like mine
A guarantee that the money can't go down

findings.what: Black background with many numbers per card is tiring and frightening for older eyes
The safest-looking tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so they can't be compared
No explanation of whether a track is like a deposit or how its risk compares
Fee shown only as a percentage, with no shekel amount and no 'per year'
Jargon and English letters with no explanation (מט"ח, סחיר, עוקב מדד, S&P 500)
Big share-track returns like 24.04% stand out and could tempt or mislead
Unclear who the site 'מקור' is, so it's hard to trust
Coloured rings with two close colours mean nothing without words
